## Validation

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] `npm run package:check` when package contents, docs shipped to npm, or release files changed
- [ ] `npm run installer:audit` when install scripts or agent setup behavior changed
- [ ] Documentation updated when CLI, MCP, graph schema, dashboard, or security behavior changed
- [ ] Security-sensitive paths considered when touching indexing, file walking, graph imports, dashboard APIs, install scripts, or workflows
- [ ] Generated artifacts reviewed so local databases, graph packages, private reports, and context packs are not committed
